summary_1line: Vyasa narrates a myth where the gods fear human overpopulation, leading to Indra’s humiliation by Shiva and discovery of four Indra-like beings in a mountain cave.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra stands beside the river Bhagirathi watching a weeping radiant woman whose falling tears turn into golden lotuses on the water.
On a snowy Himalayan peak, Shiva and a young woman sit on a throne calmly playing dice while the angry Indra confronts them.
After lifting a huge stone in the mountain, Indra peers into a dark cave and sees four other sunlike beings who look exactly like himself.
